label: DEXI Tag Navigation
info:
Tag-to-tag navigation as a flow.

ONE generic command node ('DEXI command → request' + 'DEXI services') talks to both on-board services; the mission is a list of steps inside the 'mission' function node. Start it from the RC hand-off (channel 7 to Offboard), from the ENGAGE button here, or START for bench/sim use.

Sequence on the aircraft: ARM hand-off once after deploy → pilot takes off and hovers over any tag → pilot flips Offboard → tag_nav reports engaged → mission runs → lands. Leaving Offboard stands the mission down.
